name: Catastrophic Monsoon Flood (Real 2023 Case)
headline: Torrential monsoon rains submerge 4,000 hectares of tomato nurseries in Nashik and Niphad; supply corridors to Mumbai and Delhi paralyzed.
expected_market_effect: Supply destruction prevents expected seasonal crash; prices remain elevated or stable.

name: Statewide Transporters Strike
headline: Maharashtra Truck Drivers Association declares indefinite strike; tomato dispatches halted across 12 APMC yards.
expected_market_effect: Arrival gluts cannot reach terminal markets; localized crash at farm gates, but urban wholesale prices spike.

name: Favorable Climate / Bumper Crop Influx
headline: Optimal winter temperatures trigger early ripening; arrivals surge 140% above seasonal baseline across Western Maharashtra.
expected_market_effect: Massive supply influx amplifies crash probability; severe downward price pressure.

name: Standard Equilibrium Trading
headline: Regular seasonal arrivals observed; transport freight rates steady and auctions proceeding normally.
expected_market_effect: No exogenous distortion; model relies purely on spatial-temporal momentum.
